text:
Alex K.: starting a gated rollout for kernel v3.2.1 + quant-build q8-night. target: low-latency buckets only (night bucket first). will be a staggered 5/20/100 percent over 3 windows.
deploy-bot: started rollout: kernel=3.2.1, quant=q8-night, policy=gated, stages=[5,20,100], window_start=2026-03-20T02:00Z
Mira S.: noted. monitoring: 99th latency, error rate, and tail OOMs. can we add a quick perf check at 5% after 10m?
Priya (SRE): +1 to 10m smoke. define abort triggers: latency +20% p99 vs baseline OR error rate >0.5% absolute OR new OOMs in infra buckets.
Dan R.: also watch token-per-second throughput on worker nodes — quant builds sometimes change throughput distribution. if throughput drops >15% for 2 consecutive 5m windows abort.
Lee: flag for model-compat: this quant build rewrites matmul kernel path. please ensure fallback to matmul-v1 on failure is enabled.
Alex K.: good call. deploy-bot, enable fallback-policy=matmul-v1 for this rollout.
deploy-bot: applied config: fallback_policy=matmul-v1 for rollout 1878001111
Mira S.: ops checklist: (1) schedule canary metrics alert: #canary-watch (2) make a pinned rollback artifact available in case we need an immediate pin.
Alex K.: created pin artifact: `pin artifact kernel@3.1.9-legacy` and uploaded to s3://redwood-builds/pins/3.1.9-legacy.tar.gz
Priya (SRE): if we need emergency pin, run: 
```
deploy-bot pin --service=runtime --kernel=3.1.9-legacy --scope=night-bucket --reason="emergency rollback"
```
Dan R.: suggest we also pre-close the night bucket to test fallback behavior before increasing to 20%. run a dry-run of fallback on one node group.
Lee: I'll run dry-run on ng-night-2 in 5m and post logs.
Lee: dry-run logs: fallback selected matmul-v1 on 2/2 attempted cases, no crashes, 1.2% latency delta (expected). link: https://logs.redwood/s/1878001111/dryrun
Mira S.: after dry-run, go ahead with 5% for 10m. I'll watch alerts and metric dashboards.
deploy-bot: stage 1 (5%) completed at 1878001511. metrics snapshot: p50 delta +0.4%, p95 +1.1%, p99 +3.5%, error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.08%).
Alex K.: p99 +3.5% is within the +20% abort threshold, error rate fine. move to 20% at next window.
Priya (SRE): agreed. schedule next increment in 25m. I'll standby.
Dan R.: reminder: change window note — avoid region us-west-2 maintenance window at 03:40Z. keep staging to other regions if spike.
Alex K.: ack. staging will avoid us-west-2.
Mira S.: if anything looks off, we use the pin command above and also open a rollback ticket `#rollbacks` with the rollout id.
Lee: 20% in progress. posting quick perf snippet: `topcpuload` on sidecars shows stable.
deploy-bot: stage 2 (20%) completed at 1878002311. metrics snapshot: p50 +0.3%, p95 +1.6%, p99 +5.8%, error rate 0.18%. throughput -6% peak.
Priya (SRE): p99 +5.8% still ok. throughput -6% under the -15% abort. continuing to 100% in scheduled window by default unless we see new alerts.
Mira S.: enabling extended tracing for 1h to capture any rare regressions.
Alex K.: plan for final ramp at 03:00Z. @Priya (SRE) & @Mira S. on-call for final ramp. if we hit any abort criteria, we'll pin and open rollback.
Priya (SRE): on it.
Dan R.: FYI leaving a small note in release notes: "kernel v3.2.1: matmul path change, default q8-night quant profile. Fallback to matmul-v1 if errors."
Alex K.: thanks all. post-rollout followups: add a perf test exercising long-seq generation (8k) to validate kv cache paths tomorrow.
Lee: will add test to nightly-e2e.
Mira S.: closing thread when rollout reaches 100% or abort with logs attached. :eyes:
